## Definition
The process of imprinting input signal features into the temporal evolution of a physical system (e.g., photonic or electronic) used as a reservoir, enabling analog computation. Leverages natural physical dynamics for signal processing, aligning with neuromorphic in-network computing paradigms for real-time, low-power operation.
